body:
Vague descriptor. 
```suggestion
			If set to a positive value, overrides the oversampling factor of the viewport this font is used in. See [member Viewport.oversampling].
```

Because it's not stated explicitly, it's not clear if this also overrides the `oversampling` parameter for the canvas items? I assume no...?

The name is also a bit confusing now, because FontFile has `oversampling` but Viewport has `oversampling_override`, but _based on this description_ this property acts more as an override than the other.

Also applies to the other descriptions
